# GitHub listing copy

## Repository name

```
brevity
```

## About description (shown under the repo name, 350 characters max)

```
Build HTML emails that survive Gmail. Blocks, circular photo frames, themes, drawn or typed signatures, and one-click copy into a Gmail compose window. One file, no build step, nothing leaves the browser.
```

Shorter alternative, if you want room for the Pages link:

```
A one-file HTML email builder that works inside Gmail's limits. Blocks, circular photo frames, themes and signatures.
```

## First release notes (v1.0.0)

```
Brevity 1.0.0

A one-file builder for HTML emails that survive Gmail.

Composing
- Fourteen block types, edited directly on the canvas
- Drag to reorder, keyboard shortcuts, full undo and redo

Photos
- Circular frames baked into the image, so Gmail cannot square them off
- Drop, paste or pick; drag to reposition inside the frame and zoom
- Header logos, with transparent PNGs kept transparent

Signatures
- Draw with mouse, finger or stylus, smoothed and speed-tapered
- Or type your name in one of four handwriting styles

Style
- Eighteen palettes, plus main, second and background colours by hand
- Page corners, button shape and spacing

Layouts
- Twenty-one starters, written as working drafts
- Save your own layouts, and reset back to the original

Before you send
- Checklist for missing subjects, placeholder photos, missing alt text
  and unlinked buttons
- Size meter against Gmail's 102 KB clipping threshold
- Copy for Gmail, copy HTML, download .html, or copy plain text

Everything stays in the browser. No server, no accounts, no analytics.
```

## One-line summary for a link post

```
Brevity: compose a newsletter, paste it into Gmail, and have it arrive looking the way you built it.
```
